# Incident report: checkout payment failures, 2026-11-05

**Severity:** SEV1 (checkout-web error rate was 17.6%, above the 10% SEV1 threshold for checkout/payments)
**Status:** Mitigated. Recovery checked against metrics. Follow-ups are still open.
**Impact window:** 14:02 – 14:31 UTC (~29 min)

## Impact
- checkout-web 5xx error rate went from 0.3% to **17.6%**, starting 14:03 UTC.
- payments-api p99 latency went from 420 ms to **3150 ms** (7.5× normal), and its error rate reached 18.3%.
- Customers who failed at the payment step got a 502 from payments-api. checkout-web logged 112 of these in one minute.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:15 cfg_0412: tax-service DB pool raised from 50 to 80. Unrelated (no errors followed it).
- 13:41 dep_7781: payments-api v2.14.0 deployed. Metrics stayed healthy until 14:02 (p99 412 ms at 13:55), so this deploy is not the cause.
- **14:02 flg_2210: `tax_engine_v2` rollout ramped from 10% to 100%** (release-train).
- 14:02:20 tax-service: /v2/quote queue depth 812, against a limit of 200. Log says "v2 quote path is provisioned for 10% of traffic".
- 14:02:31 onward: payments-api `TaxEngineV2` calls to tax-service /v2/quote time out after 3000 ms, and payments-api returns `POST /charge 502`.
- 14:03 checkout-web errors reach 17.6%. Alerts alt_31 (14:03) and alt_32 (14:06) fire.
- 14:05 dep_7790: search-api deploy. Happened after the errors started, on an unrelated service. It probably explains the search-api latency warning (alt_33), but it is not related to checkout.
- 14:27 Status page updated to "identified". Flag set back to 10%. payments, storefront and security teams paged.
- 14:31 checkout-web errors at 0.4%, payments-api errors at 0.3%, p99 at 450 ms. Stayed there through 14:34.
- 14:35 Status page updated to "mitigated".

## Root cause
Change **flg_2210** raised the `tax_engine_v2` flag from 10% to 100% of payments-api traffic. The tax-service /v2/quote path only has capacity for 10% of traffic. Its queue backed up and its worker pool ran out, so payments-api tax-quote calls timed out at 3 s. Those timeouts became 502s on charge requests, which showed up as failed checkouts. tax-service /v1 stayed healthy the whole time.

## Mitigation
Set `tax_engine_v2` back to its previous rollout of 10%, following the runbook (a flag revert is preferred over a rollback). No deploys were rolled back, because neither dep_7781 nor dep_7790 is linked to the errors.

## Verification
- checkout-web error_rate_pct: 0.4% from 14:31 to 14:34 (under the 1% threshold)
- payments-api error_rate_pct: 0.3%. p99 latency: 450 ms (baseline is about 420 ms).

## Security finding
A payments-api DEBUG log line at **2026-11-05T14:07:44Z** contains outbound tax-service request headers, including a live bearer credential in the Authorization header. The value is deliberately left out of this report. The security team has been paged to rotate the credential, clean up the logs and stop header logging.

## Follow-ups
1. payments: do not ramp `tax_engine_v2` again until tax-service /v2/quote has capacity for 100% of traffic. Ramp up in steps, with gates on latency and errors.
2. payments: return a fallback to the v1 quote, or fail fast, when /v2 times out, rather than returning a 502 on charge.
3. security/payments: rotate the exposed credential, scrub the logs and redact Authorization headers at every log level.
4. search team: look into the search-api latency warning after dep_7790. It is a separate issue from this incident.
5. Post a "resolved" status update after a full monitoring period with no errors.

```json
{"severity": "SEV1", "root_cause_change_id": "flg_2210", "mitigation": "Reverted feature flag tax_engine_v2 rollout from 100% to its previous 10%", "verified_recovery": true, "teams_paged": ["payments", "storefront", "security"]}
```
